mapper.select: select id, account_no, owner_name, country, currency, balance, frozen_balance, kyc_level, daily_limit, single_limit, status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_account where account_no = #{accountNo}
select id, account_no, owner_name, country, currency, balance, frozen_balance, kyc_level, daily_limit, single_limit, status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_account where id = #{id}
select id, account_no, owner_name, country, currency, balance, frozen_balance, kyc_level, daily_limit, single_limit, status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_account order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into cross_border_account (account_no, owner_name, country, currency, balance, frozen_balance, kyc_level, daily_limit, single_limit, status) values (#{accountNo}, #{ownerName}, #{country}, #{currency}, #{balance}, #{frozenBalance}, #{kycLevel}, #{dailyLimit}, #{singleLimit}, #{status})
mapper.update: update cross_border_account set balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
